'''Port Nowhere''', originally known as the '''Potentate Pride''', was a [[Space station/Legends|spaceport]] located in uncharted space during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
The Port Nowhere started out as an [[Azalus-class Hutt dreadnaught|''Azalus''-class Hutt dreadnaught]], originally owned by [[Barabbula|Barabulla the Hutt]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] sold the station to starship mechanic [[Delcan Finyaft]] at a steep discount without his full comprehension. Finyaft spent the next six years deconstructing and refitting the station and re-opened it, renamed as Port Nowhere and advertised as a floating cantina.<ref name="TORC" /> The spaceport was a haven for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and other criminals due to its anonymous location, which shifted from time to time as the mobile station traveled between the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TORC" /> Port Nowhere provided several features including [[Cantina/Legends|bars]], [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], and [[Prostitute/Legends|night entertainment]].<ref name="TOR3" />

During the start, and for the duration, of the [[Galactic War]], the [[Voidhound]] occasionally visited Port Nowhere, and also averted an Imperial attack once while on the station, during their campaign against the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]].

After the defeat of the Voidwolf, the smuggler-turned-crime lord known as the [[Voidhound]] began using Port Nowhere as a base of operations, managing the new criminal empire from the constantly moving station.

[[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Theron Shan]] made a stop at Port Nowhere to gain clearances and navigation charts for [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial space]] and in the process fought off and knocked unconscious a spaceport [[Police officer/Legends|security officer]].<ref name="TOR3">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 3|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 3]]</ref>

At some point, Port Nowhere suffered a malfunction of its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and was stranded in space, effectively becoming a normal non-moving station.<ref name="TORC" />

After the formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]], the leader of the station, the "[[Elarea Aldraste|Red Huntress]]," began raiding Alliance settlements where military presence was next to none, being made up of farmers and peaceful civilians. As a response, the [[Alliance Commander]] lead a team of elite operatives, along with the [[Eternal Alliance Recon Unit|Alliance Recon Unit]], to take the station. Suffering medium casualties on the Huntresses side, herself being one, the ports remaining personnel joined the Alliance, stating they respected the Commander's aptitude in combat. Port Nowhere began taking orders from Head of Underworld Logistics [[Hylo Visz]].
